summary: Phase 6 Field Adoption Sprint frontend verification: WS1+WS5 docs exist; WS2/WS3 completion banners (incident + daily report) verified across slate/rose/emerald tones, signal-driven gap detection (schedule_delays + safety_incidents), severity-escalation auto-expand on serious incidents, EN+ES parity, and 390px mobile rendering. 15/15 behaviors PASS. Submit-refusal guard not exercised end-to-end (spec explicitly permits banner-only verification to avoid 4-photo upload dependency).
verified_behaviors: PASS · /incidents/submit renders data-testid='incident-completion-summary' on mount with slate tone, text 'Ready to submit · follow-up optional for this severity' (default near-miss).

PASS · After selecting severity-medical, banner switches to rose with label 'ATTENTION · 3 section(s) need attention · Complete the highlighted section or mark it not used today.' (rose border-rose-300 bg-rose-50).
PASS · Selecting severity-near_miss reverts banner to slate default — regression (Tier-2 stays optional).
PASS · /daily/submit renders data-testid='daily-completion-summary' on mount with slate tone 'Optional sections available · add only what applies'.
PASS · schedule_delays=Yes without delay_description → rose 'ATTENTION · 1 section(s) need attention · Delay details · Complete the highlighted section or mark it not used today.'
PASS · safety_incidents=Yes without safety_notified=Yes → rose 'ATTENTION · 1 section(s) need attention · Safety escalation · ...'

PASS · ES parity: localStorage.setItem('masci.lang','es') + reload → incident banner reads 'ESTADO · Listo para enviar · seguimiento opcional para esta severidad', medical state reads 'ATENCIÓN · 3 sección(es) requieren atención · Completa la sección resaltada o márcala como no aplica hoy.', daily default reads 'ESTADO · Secciones opcionales disponibles · agrega solo lo que aplique'.
PASS · 390px mobile: no horizontal scroll on /daily/submit; banner copy wraps inside max-w-4xl container with 'flex items-start gap-2' layout.
PASS · Phase 5D draft-recovery toast ('Draft recovered · Your unsent daily report was restored.') still renders on /daily/submit (useDraftSync regression OK).
PASS · FILES — /app/memory/FIELD_SHADOW_VALIDATION_KIT.md exists with 5 role-based tests (Superintendent · Foreman · Safety Manager · Dispatcher · PM).
PASS · FILES — /app/memory/NOTIFICATION_DISCIPLINE_MATRIX.md exists with tier definitions, 19-row event matrix, 4 aggregation rules, 5-question discipline checklist.
PASS · FILES — /app/memory/PHASE6_FIELD_ADOPTION_SPRINT_RESULTS.md exists summarising the sprint.
PASS · CollapseCard.jsx exposes new attentionOpen prop (line 34) with useEffect auto-expand (lines 47-48).
PASS · NewIncident.jsx wires attentionOpen on sections 05 (rootCauseCount===0), 07 (!correctiveFilled), 08 (!notificationsTracked) gated by attemptedSubmit && isSeriousIncident.

PASS · i18n.js contains all 11 EN→ES keys (Operationally complete, section(s) need attention, Complete the highlighted section..., Ready to submit · follow-up optional..., Optional sections available..., sections filled today, Delay details, Safety escalation, Attention, Status, Operationally complete · ready to submit).
not_directly_exercised: Emerald 'Operationally complete · ready to submit' state on serious incident after filling Tier-2 — banner tone-derivation logic is the same code path verified via rose/slate transitions; emerald only differs in the tone string returned by incidentCompletionTone derivation.

Submit-refusal toast on serious-severity submit attempt — would require uploading 4 photos to clear validate(); per review-request guidance ('you can verify the banner WITHOUT actually submitting — just observe the data-testid'), skipped to keep scope focused. Code review of NewIncident.jsx confirms submit() includes incidentMissingSections.length > 0 guard with toast.error.
ViewIncident.jsx /admin/incidents/dd3d8d33-... rose Follow-Up Required banner — already covered by Phase 5D retest (100% pass); no Phase 6 changes touched ViewIncident.jsx.
critical_code_review_comments: NewIncident.jsx is 1306 lines — exceeds 700-line soft limit. Recommend extracting completion-banner derivation (incidentCompletionTone/Label + incidentMissingSections) into a custom hook to ease future maintenance.
NewDailyReport.jsx similarly large; same recommendation for drCompletionLabel/drAttentionItems derivation.
Banner copy is correctly localised via t() — no hardcoded English strings observed on the banner path.
test_credentials: Public-mode URLs /incidents/submit and /daily/submit used — no auth required per review-request.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 6 banner work is fully verified at the behavioural layer. If a future iteration changes the severity-escalation lockOpen logic, re-run the medical → rose test and confirm section-05/07/08 CollapseCards remain visually open. Memorial Day modal currently overlays the top of public forms; in tests, dismiss via Escape or it can intercept clicks on first paint. ES locale switch requires localStorage.setItem('masci.lang','es') + page reload — not reactive without reload.
rca of the issue: n/a — no failures encountered. Note: in an early test run, the EN medical-severity click appeared to not register; root cause was the Memorial Day remembrance modal intercepting the first click. Mitigation: press Escape to dismiss before clicking severity buttons on public forms.
